# Resolution

## Unique function
`run`

## Ambiguous across files
`shared`

## Ambiguous methods
`go`

## Qualified with ambiguous tail
`Alpha.go`

## Qualified by class
`Beta.other`

## Qualified by file stem
`c.area`

## Qualified by directory
`pkg.Beta`

## Wrong qualifier
`Alpha.other`

## Wrong case
`alpha`

## Trailing parens
`Gamma()`

## Nested function
`inner_helper`

## Denylisted names
`Data` `str`

## Uppercase class
`HTTP`

## Not callable
`lowerValue` `Red`

## TS enum is denylisted Color
`Color`

## TS interface
`Shape`

## Rust is never callable
`rusty` `Crab`

## External module
`os`

## File name
`a.py`

## Call syntax
`run(1)`

## Padded
` run `

## Twice in one section
`tsFn` first, then `tsFn` again and ``Gamma`` in double backticks.
